'''Chapter 7 - A Teila Fire and Ice''' is the seventh chapter of [[Rejuvenation]]. The chapter begins after the player defeats [[Crawli]] and obtains the Infested Badge. After securing the Earth Relic, the group must finish the Terajuma Trial to obtain the remaining two Relics so they can finally stop [[Team Xen]]'s Terajuma incursion, but another foe is getting prepared to act.

==Chapter Summary==
===A Short Respite===

The chapter begins with a short scene in the [[Team Xen]] HQ, where the Executives once again bicker amongst themselves, before leaving to continue their respective plans. Another scene shortly follows, where the [[Protagonist]] is visited in their dream by a vision of a [[Angie|mysterious woman]]. Downstairs, the group finds out that the inhabitants of [[Kakori Village]] prepared a meal for them, and have a little festival waiting for them on [[Terajuma Beach]], which the group promptly leaves for. After some time, the [[Protagonist]], [[Melia]] and [[Aelita]] are informed that there will be two musical numbers, with one of the performers being none other than [[Venam]], who is incredibly relieved after finding out [[Melia]] is actually alive. When the musical number begins, the second number is revealed to be [[Amber]], who, after finding [[Venam]] and [[Saki]], dislikes their presence so much that she immediately leaves, leaving the show ruined. The group slightly salvages the situation by having a Tag Battle, after which the defeated [[Saki]] runs off and [[Venam]] is punished for having lied her way into performing and ruining the show.

After the hectic day, [[Melia]], [[Aelita]] and the [[Protagonist]] return home, where [[Crawli]] finally accepts their request to undertake the Terajuma Trial in its fullest. With the Earth Relic being in the [[Teila Resort]] and the Ocean Relic being in [[Kristiline Town]], [[Crawli]] tells everyone about how a woman named [[Angie]] suddenly appeared in Kristiline some time ago, freezing the whole place and taking the population captive. [[Crawli]] himself tried to take her down, but was easily defeated and could only be saved by the appearance of a Pokémon he later recognized as Tapu Koko.
The next day, September 8th, the group is ready to head to the [[Teila Resort]].

===The Aquamarine Cave===

Not having seen [[Saki]] in a while, the group finds out through a short transmission from her that she is probably in a cave, with the only unexplored cave nearby being [[Aquamarine Cave]]. Inside, the group proceeds to try and find her and, eventually, they hear a scream that could only be from their lost friend. After finding a secret passage through a waterfall and solving a puzzle that opens a mysterious door, the gang defeats a [[Team Xen]] mage and finds [[Saki]] unhurt. With the group whole again, everyone makes their way to the exit, but not before 2 mysterious figures seem to observe and comment on how [[Melia]] and the [[Protagonist]] need more experience to provide meaningful data.

Finally making our way to the [[Teila Resort]], we meet [[Tesla]], the manager, who informs us that the Earth Relic can only be obtained after a ritual that only [[Amber]] can do. However, [[Amber]] hasn't been cooperative, and so we'll have to go ask her at her hidden spot deep within [[Aquamarine Cave]]. With the TM for Rock Climb, the [[Protagonist]], [[Aelita]] and [[Melia]] eventually find [[Amber]] in a secluded part of the cave, where, after some arguing, she agrees to perform the ritual, as long as the group leaves as soon as it's finished. Back at the Resort, since the ritual will take around two days to fully prepare, the group stays in one of the Resort's houses for the time being. Before the day ends, there is a short scene where the player can see a big explosion going off at [[Valor Mountain]], where [[Geara]] and [[Zetta]] are stationed.

The next morning, one of the Rangers informs the group that they are aware of the big explosion that happened the day prior, but there is nothing they can do about it. While informing [[Tesla]] about it, a distressed [[Amber]] shows up to complain that someone unknown is now living in her secret spot and has asked to talked to [[Tesla]], to which she agrees. After returning, she asks the [[Protagonist]], [[Melia]] and [[Aelita]] to go with her to meet the unknowne person, who is none other than [[Jenner]], who escaped [[Team Xen]] in the previous night's explosion and is now in hiding. The player can choose whether or not to trust him, but regardless he asks for a battle to confirm the [[Protagonist]]'s strength and gives out some Pokémon as a gift.

===Trial for a Relic===

The next day, the [[Protagonist]] is informed that the trial is finally ready and, accompanied by [[Adam]] and [[Saki]], they make their way to the [[Magrodar Crater]]. Defeating the trainers that make up the trial, we finally arrive at the top, where [[Amber]] finalizes the ritual by calling out a shiny Charizard. However, the Tapu Koko from earlier intervenes and, after defeating both in battle, it tells the [[Protagonist]] to keep getting stronger. Regardless, the trial is finished and the group obtains the Earth Relic. [[Amber]] insists that group now has to leave, but not before her mother invites the [[Protagonist]] to have dinner at her house.

At [[Tesla]]'s house, we learn more about her and [[Amber]]'s situation and, when [[Tesla]] offers the now empty room of her missing husband to the [[Protagonist]], [[Amber]] snaps and, after arguing with her mother, bolts off to her room. There, we finally hear the whole story behind [[Amber]]'s frustration and dislike for [[Saki]] and [[Venam]], which makes her feel instantly better. [[Amber]] then asks to accompany the [[Protagonist]] in taking some of the cake they made to [[Jenner]] in the cave.

===Team Xen makes a Move===

After running into [[Melia]] in the cave, the four are ambushed by [[Team Xen]] Deathwings. [[Amber]] and the Professor try to distract them so the two more important targets can flee, but [[Madelis]] and her grunts quickly block the other path. After escaping through Rock Climbing a wall, [[Melia]] and the [[Protagonist]] are almost caught in a dead-end, but [[Amber]] and [[Jenner]] create a distraction so they can flee once again. After defeating [[Madelis]], the two fugitives make their way out of the cave, but not between hearing that their saviors have been captured.

The pair makes their way to [[Tesla]]'s office, but find it empty. Eventually, a massive group of [[Team Xen]] members, including [[Neved]], catch up to them, forcing them into a series of battles to wear them out. [[Neved]] eventually explains that he believes the pair should surrender in order to spare everyone else in the island, since, even if every Executive were to turn, noone can stop [[Madame X]]'s plan. When it seems there is no hope left, [[Tesla]] shows up and manages to rout [[Team Xen]], with [[Neved]] leaving disappointed. [[Tesla]] feels guilty that [[Amber]] was caught up in danger and leaves to try and get to [[Valor Mountain]]. On the way out, the group meets a weakened [[Crawli]] carrying bad news: [[Angie]] and her servants attacked [[Kakori Village]] and froze most of the town and its inhabitants. Horrified, and considering that the Ocean Relic was in [[Kristiline Town]] anyway, the gang decides to finally bring the fight to [[Angie]].

===Breaking the Ice===

[[Crawli]] informs us that a woman who managed to escape [[Kristiline Town]] is residing at the [[Ranger HQ]] and could possibly tell us how to access the town. After tracking her down and learning she escaped in a submarine from the museum, the gang is ready to head out to the frozen town. In Kristiline, the Rangers and some members of the group fight off [[Angie]]'s servants, leaving only the [[Protagonist]], [[Melia]], [[Venam]] and [[Crawli]] left to storm the church where [[Angie]] resides. Eventually the four make their way to the farthest room in the church where [[Angie]] and her main servant, [[Cera]], are waiting for them. [[Angie]] proposes a game: escape the [[Tower of Theolia]] and we may confront her. 

After being teleported to the Tower, which seems to be outside of the island they were just on, the [[Protagonist]] and their friends find themselves separated, having to climb the tower all the way to the top. However, all of them are eventually attacked and frozen in place by [[Angie]], although [[Crescent]] shows up once again to save the [[Protagonist]] for the last time. As the [[Protagonist]] keeps climbing, they find [[Crawli]] trapped in a cocoon, being kept there by a Volcarona. After rescuing him, the two keep making their way down, and discover Tapu Koko freeing its fellow guardians of the ice, although [[Crawli]] notes this Tapu Koko is not the same color as the one the [[Protagonist]] previously saw. Farther up, the two find [[Venam]] locked in a cell, and have to win a quiz game against [[Angie]]'s servants to free her. The three proceed to the next room, where they find a mysterious man locked in a cell, who introduces himself as [[Kreiss]], the actual Ice-type Gym Leader who had come to confront the one pretending to be him. After he is freed, he agrees to join the group.

[[File:Chapter07_4.png|thumb|Part of the arena where the Protagonist fights Angie.]]
After some puzzles, the group finds [[Melia]] and [[Angie]], who seems to plan some sort of ritual with the girl. The group is unable to act in time, but something appears to go wrong with the ritual and the room is destroyed, with [[Angie]] leaving and [[Melia]] nowhere to be seen. Eventually she is found in the next room, apparently confused and saying nonsense. [[Kreiss]] brings her back to her senses and the group carry on, eventually arriving at the final room, where they find a frozen Tapu Koko and an enraged [[Angie]], who battles the [[Protagonist]].

===A Town saved===

The defeated [[Angie]] grows even more enraged and knocks part of the group back, forcing them to run for their lives as she rains down ice from above. When it seems like she's going to get a hit, [[Angie]] is interrupted by [[Adam]], [[Valarie]], [[Braixen]], [[Aelita]] and [[Saki]], who combine their strength to push [[Angie]] back. The now unfrozen Island Guardians (including the two Tapu Koko) assist in the beatdown, and [[Kreiss]] and his Froslass finish the job by freezing [[Angie]] solid with an Ice Beam. Before the group can properly celebrate, however, [[Melia]], [[Venam]] and even the [[Protagonist]] suddenly collapse, and the chapter ends.

==Trivia==

* Like in the previous chapters, Chapter 7 saw some changes to its story and plot progression with update 13.5, although less so than then previous two.
** Before the update, when [[Saki]] was thrown off the ship during the arrival at [[Terajuma Island]], she would remain absent from the story until she was found in [[Aquamarine Cave]], instead of just temporarily making her way there.
** [[Angie]] had also never attacked [[Kakori Village]], with [[Crawli]] also not being present during the raid on the [[Tower of Theolia]].
* In an optional room near the top of the [[Tower of Theolia]], the player can watch a short scene depicting something that happened to a previous version of [[Angie]], turning her into the present version of herself.
